title: pillager survival level fills from SP beside health and stays with the living pillager
why: His season zero answers 16, 17, 19, 20, 29 and 52: tie survival level to every SP award, keep filling through levels, cap at 20, and place it next to health. Career kills, shared machine SP, styles, vaults, bounties and strongholds use the existing SP tally. Extraction credits only the final score difference once. The saved living record holds SP and level; old records start at zero. The existing death and hall rules keep the ended level. The demo and same-PC player 2 lineage exception stay as before. The curve is total SP = 700*level + 165*level*level, cap 80000. Level 0..20 totals: 0,865,2060,3585,5440,7625,10140,12985,16160,19665,23500,27665,32160,36985,42140,47625,53440,59585,66060,72865,80000. The Nov 7 recorder has 15 successful real raids among its latest 60: median base kill SP 1950, mean 2040. With elite types unknown, allocating plain elite premiums uniformly among killed types estimates mean 2243.50 live kill SP. The latest exported settings imply the current 1.10 score multiplier, and extraction doubles score, estimating mean 4935.69 and median 5209.29 SP per surviving raid before medals, vaults, bounties, strongholds and condition extras. These are estimates, not recorded SP totals. Thus a typical early live raid crosses 2 levels, extraction reaches 3, and 80000 takes about 15 surviving raids at roughly 5200 SP each; later levels cost more. Watch: the recorder omits exact career SP, so compare the first two surviving raids and the climb toward level 20 against that intended pace. Watch: the health stack moves up 42 local HUD pixels to hold the new row, including its bounds, medal feed fallback and TV belt clearance. LINKED REVIEW NEEDED: synced, the existing state packet carries the separate display field pl.
now: Career raids: pillager survival level beside health, short level n callout, cap 20. SP and levels persist on the living pillager. No picks in this build.
